notes: Counts are participants with AAD, not episodes. Efficacy analysis used the 555 completers (282 probiotic mix; 273 placebo), described as a modified intention-to-treat population. Randomized totals were 285 and 279, respectively; 3 and 6 discontinued early without efficacy data and were excluded. These randomized totals also apply to the safety analysis. Overall AAD incidence is selected; antibiotic-class subgroups and mild/moderate AAD are separately reported secondary or subgroup results. AAD was defined as at least 3 loose or liquid stools over 24 hours.
